# Data Source: catalyst_organizations

List Catalyst organizations visible to the authenticated account in the configured data center, using the official CLI's organization lookup. Configure a provider without a specific organization for account-wide discovery. Requires OAuth access to the organization list. The minimum scope still needs live verification.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_organizations" "visible" {}

output "organization_ids" {
  value = data.catalyst_organizations.visible.organizations[*].id
}
```

## Attribute Reference

- `organizations` (Attributes List) Visible organization identities sorted lexicographically by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Organization ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether Catalyst reports the organization as the default, when available.
- `name` (String) Organization name reported by Catalyst.
